note: Spec 1 /2 closure. /2 documents carry the same fields as /1; the only semantic change is the strict equity ticker and the closed-charset masked label. Every reject is single-cause and names the exact message both languages emit. frozen_weakness entries are ACCEPTED by the frozen /1 validator and REFUSED by /2. Chain cases: version cases pass every version-blind check, so the version rule is their only refusal; member cases hand the gates raw, never-validated documents and inputs that the version-blind logic accepts, so re-validation is their only refusal; branch cases are valid /2 chains that each reach one refusal branch of the shared chain and commit logic. Pure ASCII: non-ASCII values are JSON escapes.
